query: SELECT role_binding.workspace_id AS "workspace_id!", role_permission.permission_id AS "permission_id!", (role_binding.scope_id = role_binding.workspace_id) AS "is_workspace_scope!", role_binding.scope_id AS "scope_id!" FROM actor INNER JOIN role_binding ON role_binding.actor_id = actor.id INNER JOIN role_permission ON role_permission.role_id = role_binding.role_id WHERE actor.actor_type = 'user' AND actor.user_id = $1;
